notes.title: New Game Announced
notes.notes:
I’m excited to announce that I am currently working on what I consider to be one of my “dream games.”

[b]As Time Surrenders[/b] (aka No Sun To Worship 2) is a much bigger project with a lot more polish than my previous games. It’s a new type of challenge that has pushed me beyond my usual methods and routines.

I wrote a free article with a lot more info: https://www.patreon.com/posts/what-is-as-time-101120200

Let's goooo!
